messages:
marta: Kicking off a small GPTQ bakeoff across Llama-2-13b, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B. Goal: get 3 quant profiles into catalog (gptq-8k, gptq-16k, awq-int8) and sanity-check MMLU / perplexity / coding pass rates. Starting with 5 eval shards.
jason: Nice. Which dataset shards are you running and any prompt template variants?
tessa: +1 on templates — zero-shot vs 5-shot can change coding numbers a lot.
marta: shards = mmlu_shard1..5 + lambada_small + codeparrot_subset. Running both zero-shot and 5-shot quick checks.
tessa: Can you paste the exact eval command you used?
marta: ```
./run_eval.sh --model llama2-13b --quant gptq-8k --shards 1-5 --metrics mmlu,acc,perplexity --out results/llama2-gptq8k.json
```
infra-bot: Started job 4821 on cluster-gptq-1 (g4dn) - ETA ~42m
aakash: FYI we previously saw instability with llama2 + gptq-16k at seq>1024 (kv-cache spikes / occasional OOM). Recommend capping seq for that combo and monitoring logs.
marta: Good catch. We'll cap Llama runs to seq=1024. Mistral runs at seq=512 by default.
rachel: Preliminary from shard1 (llama2 gptq-8k): MMLU delta ~ -1.8% vs fp16, perplexity +0.6, CC answer rate -0.9. Saving diffs to results.
jason: Can you paste a tiny summary table?
marta: ```
model            | metric    | fp16  | gptq-8k | delta
llama2-13b       | mmlu      | 75.4  | 73.6    | -1.8
mistral-7b       | mmlu      | 68.2  | 67.9    | -0.3
qwen-7b          | mmlu      | 70.1  | 69.2    | -0.9
```
tessa: Interesting — Mistral is basically flat. Any per-category regressions (math/coding/closed-book)?
rachel: Llama math down ~ -2.7, coding -1.2. Qwen coding down -0.5. Full breakdown uploaded to GDrive: https://drive.re/redwood/gptq-bakeoff (perm: eng-ml)
aakash: @marta can you run AWQ-int8 for Qwen? Prior notes implied AWQ keeps coding quality better.
marta: Queued AWQ-int8 for qwen-7b and mistral-7b. infra-bot, please schedule.
infra-bot: Job 4825 scheduled on cluster-rw-2 (A10G) - ETA ~38m
jason: What are the latency / throughput differences so far?
marta: Quick bench: GPTQ ~130 tok/s for llama2 on A10G; AWQ-int8 ~210 tok/s. Cost rough estimate per 1M tokens: FP16=$12, GPTQ=$3.8, AWQ=$2.5 (back-of-envelope using reserved capacity rates).
tessa: Good to know. For deploy recommendations: maybe default=gptq-8k for safety-critical, default-lowcost=awq-int8 for qwen/mistral coding apps? Thoughts?
marta: Proposed recommendation: 
- general production: gptq-8k (balanced accuracy + cost)
- low-cost/coding-focused: awq-int8 (if coding regressions within tolerance)
Constraints: enforce seq caps and run the watchlist tests for each rollout.
rachel: Note: AWQ shows small hallucination uptick on instruction-following tests (+0.4 F1). Add to watchlist under 'instr-halluc'.
jason: Are we doing canary A/B in Console for the rollout? I can set 5% traffic canary + automatic fallback.
marta: Yes — plan = canary 5% + fallback to fp16 if 3 consecutive regressions on watchlist. I'll open the rollout PR.
devx-bot: PR created: github.com/redwood/reports/pull/324 - "gptq bakeoff rollout + profiles"
aakash: :thumbsup: I'll monitor for OOMs during the 16k runs and post logs if anything pops.
